extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a 360K 10,000 psi nitrogen pumping unit used for?
faqs.a: A nitrogen pumping unit converts liquid nitrogen to high-pressure gas for well stimulation and clean-out. This truck-mounted unit is the 360K rate class, 360,000 scf per hour (6,000 scf/min), rated 10,000 psi, with a cryogenic high-pressure reciprocating LN2 pump.

faqs.q: What does 360K mean on the 360K 10,000 psi nitrogen pumping unit?
faqs.a: 360K is the pumping-rate class: 360,000 scf of nitrogen per hour, or 6,000 scf/min. Rate classes from 90K to 1000K scf per hour are built, and the highest pressures go with the smallest classes.

faqs.q: What pressure is the 360K 10,000 psi nitrogen pumping unit rated for?
faqs.a: This unit is rated 10,000 psi. The highest pressure ratings, up to 15,000 psi, go with the smallest rate classes, so a larger-rate unit would be rated lower.

faqs.q: What does the 360K 10,000 psi nitrogen pumping unit include?
faqs.a: It includes a cryogenic high-pressure reciprocating LN2 pump, a hydraulic power pack, a heat-exchange vaporizer and an operator control cabin with a manual or electronic interface.

faqs.q: What is the modular construction of the 360K 10,000 psi nitrogen pumping unit?
faqs.a: Three independent modules interconnect on a substructure bolted to the truck chassis, which enables rapid chassis swap and independent crane lifts for offshore installation.

faqs.q: What certification and climate options does the 360K 10,000 psi nitrogen pumping unit have?
faqs.a: CE, GOST, ATEX Zone 2 and arctic winterization options are available for the nitrogen unit. State the approvals, the area classification and the ambient temperature range of the site on the RFQ.

faqs.q: How does the nitrogen unit differ from a frac pumper?
faqs.a: A nitrogen unit vaporizes liquid nitrogen and pumps gas, while a [frac pumper](/p/frac-pumper-2-500-hp-trailer-mounted-fleet-networked-dnv-optional) pumps liquid fracturing fluid. Nitrogen is used for stimulation, foam and clean-out work.

faqs.q: Where is the 360K 10,000 psi nitrogen pumping unit used?
faqs.a: It is used for nitrogen pumping in well stimulation and intervention. See the guide on [frac and stimulation equipment](/blog/frac-and-stimulation-equipment) and [nitrogen units](/c/stimulation-nitrogen-unit).

faqs.q: What should I send for a nitrogen pumping unit quotation?
faqs.a: Send the rate class, the pressure, the truck chassis and diesel engine preference, the control interface, the certification, and the area classification.

faqs.q: Which truck chassis can the 360K 10,000 psi nitrogen pumping unit be fitted to?
faqs.a: Chassis options include MAN, Scania, Volvo, DAF, Renault, Iveco, Tatra, MAZ, MAZ-MAN, NZKT, Kamaz, Kenworth and Peterbilt, with diesel engines from CAT, MTU, Detroit Diesel, Cummins, Deutz and Volvo Penta.

faqs.q: Can the nitrogen unit be lifted offshore?
faqs.a: Yes. The three independent modules allow independent crane lifts for offshore installation. State the crane limits on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the 360K 10,000 psi nitrogen pumping unit?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the 360K 10,000 psi nitrogen pumping unit as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times.
